questions.q: What ancient Aztec artifact turns Dio into a vampire?
questions.why: Dio puts on the Stone Mask after killing George Joestar and drinking his blood, and it makes him a vampire.

questions.q: In Part 3, Dio's head is attached to the body of which of his old enemies?
questions.why: Dio joins his head to the body of his old rival, which is why Stand powers awaken across that rival's whole bloodline.

questions.q: Dio is taken in as a foster son by which wealthy family?
questions.why: George Joestar adopts Dio, who then schemes against his new brother Jonathan.

questions.q: In what year did Dio first appear in the JoJo manga?
questions.why: Chapter 1 of Phantom Blood, dated January 1, 1987, introduced him.

questions.q: The name Dio comes from the Italian word for which concept?
questions.why: Araki chose a name that reads as the Italian word for God, fitting a villain with grand ambitions.

questions.q: Which studio made the 2012 JoJo's Bizarre Adventure TV anime?
questions.why: David Production adapted the series starting in 2012, after the 2007 Phantom Blood film by A.P.P.P.

questions.q: In Part 3, which hero destroys Dio's Stand and splits Dio's head in two?
questions.why: Jotaro defeats Dio, and sunlight later turns the body to ash.

questions.q: Which sci-fi film antagonist is said to have influenced Araki's look for Dio?
questions.why: Araki's look for Dio is said to borrow from Rutger Hauer's replicant Roy Batty.

questions.q: Who voices Dio in the 2012 TV anime, in Japanese?
questions.why: Koyasu has played Dio since the 2012 TV anime, after others voiced him in older OVAs and games.

questions.q: What was the first name of Dio's abusive, alcoholic father?
questions.why: Dario Brando mistreated Dio, shaping the boy's bitterness before the Joestar adoption.
